It is not a simple textbook operation, but the necessary theory and algorithms are already implemented in OpenPhase/DAMASK; the main effort is configuring the simulation correctly rather than deriving or coding a new method.

The solve.sh bypasses actual simulation, but the task specification insists on real runs, adding to the engineering burden.
